column3: Primordial beings of elemental force who slumber beyond the veil — worshipped as deities such as Sol, and fought as ancient enemies in the Third Age.
Colossal elemental beings native to Rathe; Davnir, Yvor and Galcia spent their lives in the cataclysm that broke the world of the Third Age.
Green-skinned, pointed-eared Rathenfolk of the far west.
Powerful supernatural entities that feed on blood.
A forest people, and the order of powerful spell weavers they formed, which once stood alongside the likes of the Ollin and the Seers.
